sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Margarita Perez, please proceed to a white-caging telephone and press zero.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽塔·佩雷斯，请前往白色电话亭拨打零号键。

sentences.en: I flew into the Portland airport recently, and when I got off the plane, I took a picture of my feet, in keeping with the local custom.
sentences.zh: 我最近飞抵波特兰机场，下飞机后，按照当地习俗，我拍了一张自己双脚的照片。

sentences.en: A foot selfie.
sentences.zh: 一张足部自拍。

sentences.en: That's producer Julie Sabatier, host of the podcast Rendered, formerly known as Destination DIY.
sentences.zh: 那是制片人朱莉·萨巴蒂尔，她是播客《Rendered》（前身为《Destination DIY》）的主持人。

sentences.en: She lives in Portland.
sentences.zh: 她住在波特兰。

sentences.en: And I almost always take a foot selfie when I'm at PDX, the Portland airport.
sentences.zh: 而且每当我身处波特兰机场（PDX）时，我几乎总会拍一张足部自拍。

sentences.en: I think I do it most often when I come home.
sentences.zh: 我想我回家时拍得最频繁。

sentences.en: Like, here I am.
sentences.zh: 就像这样，我到了。

sentences.en: I'm back in Portland.
sentences.zh: 我回波特兰了。

sentences.en: The feet are actually not the most important thing about a Portland airport foot selfie.
sentences.zh: 其实，波特兰机场足部自拍最重要的并不是双脚。

sentences.en: It's actually what's under your feet.
sentences.zh: 而是你脚下的东西。

sentences.en: The famous PDX airport carpet.
sentences.zh: 那块著名的PDX机场地毯。

sentences.en: It's a loud, decidedly 80s, teal color with a repeating geometric pattern.
sentences.zh: 它颜色鲜艳，带有明显的80年代风格，是那种青色底色配上重复的几何图案。

sentences.en: Like any carpet you might see in an airport, or a hotel lobby, or an office building, it's probably not what you'd choose for your living room.
sentences.zh: 就像你在机场、酒店大堂或办公楼里看到的任何地毯一样，你可能不会选择把它铺在自家客厅里。

sentences.en: The design, I'm told, is based on the way the runways and lights look from the air traffic control tower.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这个设计灵感来源于空中交通管制塔台从空中俯瞰跑道和灯光的样子。

sentences.en: And also on the radar screen that the air traffic controller sees, with that sweeping line going around and around.
sentences.zh: 也源于空中交通管制员看到的雷达屏幕，上面有一条不断旋转的扫描线。

sentences.en: And the dots are the little blips representing airplanes.
sentences.zh: 那些小圆点就是代表飞机的光点。

sentences.en: It's hard to say if it's the pattern people are responding to, or the bright teal background color.
sentences.zh: 很难说人们是因为图案而产生共鸣，还是因为那鲜艳的青色底色。

sentences.en: But one thing is for sure.
sentences.zh: 但有一点是肯定的。

sentences.en: The carpet is very, very beloved.
sentences.zh: 这块地毯非常、非常受人喜爱。

sentences.en: There are even signs in the airport now saying,
sentences.zh: 现在机场里甚至有标语写着：

sentences.en: Tweet your feet!
sentences.zh: “晒出你的双脚！”

sentences.en: With the hashtag,
sentences.zh: 并配上标签：

sentences.en: PDX Carpet.
sentences.zh: “PDX地毯”。

sentences.en: And it goes deeper than that.
sentences.zh: 而且情况远不止于此。

sentences.en: Meet Emma.
sentences.zh: 认识一下艾玛。

sentences.en: She actually has a PDX Carpet-inspired tattoo.
sentences.zh: 她甚至纹了一个受PDX地毯启发的纹身。

sentences.en: It hurt a lot.
sentences.zh: 这很疼。

sentences.en: Emma Milken is a 21-year-old Portland native,
sentences.zh: 艾玛·米尔肯是一位21岁的波特兰本地人，

sentences.en: which means a lot of the carpet in the airport is actually older than she is.
sentences.zh: 这意味着机场里很多地毯的年龄其实比她还要大。

sentences.en: She got a tattoo of the carpet pattern on her back.
sentences.zh: 她在背上纹了这个地毯的图案。

sentences.en: This side.
sentences.zh: 这一侧。

sentences.en: So yes, my left.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的左边。

sentences.en: Emma traveled a lot as a kid.
sentences.zh: 艾玛小时候经常旅行。

sentences.en: Her parents are divorced, and her dad lives in L.A.
sentences.zh: 她的父母离异了，她爸爸住在洛杉矶。

sentences.en: I think the first time I ever took a flight as an unaccompanied minor,
sentences.zh: 我想我第一次独自乘坐飞机时，

sentences.en: um, I was probably 11, and I was freaking out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我大概11岁，当时我吓坏了。

sentences.en: But the carpet had this kind of calming effect on her.
sentences.zh: 但地毯对她有一种安抚作用。

sentences.en: On my way, that was kind of like my send-off.
sentences.zh: 在路上时，那就像是我的送行仪式。

sentences.en: The carpet was there, and I knew that it would probably be there when I got home.
sentences.zh: 地毯就在那里，我知道当我回家时，它很可能还在那里。

sentences.en: Several years later, when Emma decided to take the plunge and get a tattoo of the Portland carpet design,
sentences.zh: 几年后，当艾玛决定下定决心纹一个波特兰地毯图案的纹身时，

sentences.en: she realized she was not the carpet's only admirer.
sentences.zh: 她意识到自己并不是唯一一个欣赏这块地毯的人。

sentences.en: Not by a long shot.
sentences.zh: 绝非如此。

sentences.en: When I got the tattoo, I posted a picture of it on Instagram,
sentences.zh: 当我纹完身，我在Instagram上发了一张照片，

sentences.en: and one of my followers tagged at PDX Carpet.
sentences.zh: 我的一位粉丝标记了“PDX地毯”。

sentences.en: Upon further inspection, I was like, oh my goodness, the carpet has an Instagram.
sentences.zh: 仔细一看，我心想，天哪，这块地毯竟然有Instagram账号。

sentences.en: The carpet has a Twitter and a Facebook page.
sentences.zh: 这块地毯还有Twitter和Facebook主页。

sentences.en: And that's kind of when I knew that it was this kind of notorious Portland entity.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，我知道它已经成了波特兰的一种标志性存在。

sentences.en: It's important to note that the airport communications department says
sentences.zh: 需要说明的是，机场公关部门表示，

sentences.en: they are not running any of the social media accounts devoted to the PDX Carpet.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有运营任何专门针对PDX地毯的社交媒体账号。

sentences.en: Emma says that occasionally people on social media make fun of her tattoo.
sentences.zh: 艾玛说，偶尔会有社交媒体上的人取笑她的纹身。

sentences.en: But I'm just sitting back and letting people say what they want about it.
sentences.zh: 但我只是坐视不管，随他们怎么说。

sentences.en: But I am in love.
sentences.zh: 但我确实爱它。

sentences.en: I used to live in Boston.
sentences.zh: 我以前住在波士顿。

sentences.en: I cannot imagine telling Bostonites, like,
sentences.zh: 我无法想象告诉波士顿人说，

sentences.en: I'm obsessed with the airport carpet at Logan and having someone go, yeah, me too.
sentences.zh: “我迷上了洛根机场的地毯”，然后有人回应说“我也是”。

sentences.en: Jeremy Dunn is a designer in Portland, and he's another fan of the carpet.
sentences.zh: 杰里米·邓恩是波特兰的一名设计师，他也是这块地毯的粉丝。

sentences.en: A couple of years ago, he decided to have some socks made with a carpet pattern on them.
sentences.zh: 几年前，他决定制作一些印有地毯图案的袜子。

sentences.en: He spent about $500 on the minimum order, which was 72 pairs.
sentences.zh: 他花了大约500美元订购了最低起订量，即72双。

sentences.en: So he was hoping some people would want to buy them.
sentences.zh: 所以他希望有人会想买。

sentences.en: We posted them on our Instagram account, and I think it was an hour,
sentences.zh: 我们在Instagram账号上发布了它们，我想大概过了一个小时，

sentences.en: maybe two hours, and they were all sold out.
sentences.zh: 也许两个小时，它们就全部售罄了。

sentences.en: The carpet socks were so popular that Jeremy quit his day job and opened up a retail space.
sentences.zh: 地毯袜子太受欢迎了，以至于杰里米辞掉了正职，开了一家零售店。

sentences.en: Jeremy's socks are actually sold in the airport now,
sentences.zh: 杰里米的袜子现在实际上在机场有售，

sentences.en: alongside many other items emblazoned with the carpet pattern.
sentences.zh: 旁边还有许多其他印有地毯图案的商品。

sentences.en: T-shirts, coffee mugs, throw pillows, tote bags, stickers, keychains, bike helmets, water bottles.
sentences.zh: T恤、咖啡杯、抱枕、手提袋、贴纸、钥匙扣、自行车头盔、水瓶。

sentences.en: There's even a PDX carpet IPA from a local brewery called Rogue.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一家当地啤酒厂Rogue推出的PDX地毯IPA啤酒。

sentences.en: That's what's so interesting to me about this whole carpet phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 这就是这整个地毯现象让我觉得如此有趣的地方。

sentences.en: It's great for PDX.
sentences.zh: 这对PDX来说是件好事。

sentences.en: It's basically free marketing for them.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是免费的营销。

sentences.en: But if the airport had tried to create this kind of fervor for the carpet,
sentences.zh: 但如果机场试图刻意制造这种对地毯的热情，

sentences.en: there's no way it would have caught on.
sentences.zh: 它绝对不可能流行起来。

sentences.en: At least not like this.
sentences.zh: 至少不会是现在这样。

sentences.en: I love this carpet.
sentences.zh: 我爱这块地毯。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我爱它。

sentences.en: It's like a big thing.
sentences.zh: 这成了一件大事。

sentences.en: Everyone buys socks and T-shirts.
sentences.zh: 每个人都买袜子和T恤。

sentences.en: It just kind of represents Portland.
sentences.zh: 它只是代表了波特兰。

sentences.en: We're kind of known for this at our airport, this carpet.
sentences.zh: 我们的机场以这块地毯而闻名。

sentences.en: It makes traveling a little bit more enjoyable, I guess, when I'm in the airport.
sentences.zh: 我想，当我在机场时，它让旅行变得更愉快了一些。

sentences.en: We always do the selfie, you know, the foot thing.
sentences.zh: 我们总是会拍自拍，你知道，就是那个足部自拍。

sentences.en: But maybe there's something that's just secretly magical about it.
sentences.zh: 但也许它确实有一种秘密的魔力。

sentences.en: Oh, get a room, people.
sentences.zh: 噢，你们去开个房吧。

sentences.en: People have extreme, unprecedented, inordinate amounts of affection for the carpet at PDX.
sentences.zh: 人们对PDX地毯有着极度、前所未有、超乎寻常的喜爱。

sentences.en: When you ask people why they love the carpet so much,
sentences.zh: 当你问人们为什么这么爱这块地毯时，

sentences.en: they pretty much all say the same thing.
sentences.zh: 他们几乎都说同样的话。

sentences.en: When they see it, it reminds them that they're home.
sentences.zh: 当他们看到它时，它提醒他们：他们到家了。

sentences.en: And that's sweet.
sentences.zh: 这很温馨。

sentences.en: But like so many great love stories, I'm afraid this one is coming to a tragic end.
sentences.zh: 但就像许多伟大的爱情故事一样，恐怕这个故事也要迎来悲剧性的结局了。

sentences.en: That is the sound of Portland's heart being ripped out of its cheSt.
sentences.zh: 那是波特兰的心被从胸腔中撕裂的声音。

sentences.en: Speaking of PDX, workers are replacing the airport's famous carpet.
sentences.zh: 说到PDX，工人们正在更换机场那块著名的地毯。

sentences.en: You know, that sea of teal with the red and purple and blue accents.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那片带有红色、紫色和蓝色点缀的青色海洋。

sentences.en: It's always hard to say goodbye, especially for travelers with an emotional attachment.
sentences.zh: 告别总是很难，尤其是对于那些有情感寄托的旅客来说。

sentences.en: A person came up to me and said, oh, I love your tattoo.
sentences.zh: 有个人走过来对我说，噢，我喜欢你的纹身。

sentences.en: Did you know that they've already started tearing it up?
sentences.zh: 你知道他们已经开始拆除它了吗？

sentences.en: And I just kind of felt my heart sink.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我感觉心都沉下去了。

sentences.en: For carpet, it's actually had a pretty long life.
sentences.zh: 对于地毯来说，它的寿命其实已经相当长了。

sentences.en: The oldest sections of carpet have been in the airport since the late 1980s.
sentences.zh: 最老的地毯部分自80年代末以来就一直铺在机场里。

sentences.en: There are things that you just can't repair.
sentences.zh: 有些东西是你无法修复的。

sentences.en: You can't just patch your way out of it.
sentences.zh: 你不能只靠打补丁来解决问题。

sentences.en: But it really just looks tired and like it's served its life well.
sentences.zh: 但它看起来确实很疲惫，像是已经完成了它的使命。

sentences.en: That's Robin McCaffrey.
sentences.zh: 那是罗宾·麦卡弗里。

sentences.en: She's an engineering project manager at the Port of Portland, the agency that controls the airport.
sentences.zh: 她是波特兰港务局的工程项目经理，该机构负责管理机场。

sentences.en: She's in charge of the carpet removal project, which started in late January.
sentences.zh: 她负责地毯拆除项目，该项目于1月底开始。

sentences.en: Can you describe what you're doing real quick?
sentences.zh: 你能简单描述一下你们在做什么吗？

sentences.en: I'm hooking the clamp to the carpet so the machine can pull it up.
sentences.zh: 我正在把夹具钩在地毯上，这样机器就能把它拉起来。

sentences.en: Mike Mackley works for 4M Floor Covering.
sentences.zh: 迈克·麦克利为4M地板覆盖公司工作。

sentences.en: Actually, he helped install the carpet here at the end of the sea concourse in the mid-1990s.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他在90年代中期帮助安装了这里海滨大厅尽头的地毯。

sentences.en: I laid all of this in 1995 for Rubenstein's contract carpets.
sentences.zh: 我是在1995年为鲁宾斯坦合同地毯公司铺设了所有这些地毯。

sentences.en: So do you have any kind of attachment to it?
sentences.zh: 那你对它有什么感情吗？

sentences.en: None at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也没有。

sentences.en: You're not sorry to see it go?
sentences.zh: 你不遗憾看到它被拆除吗？

sentences.en: It's just carpet, that's my opinion.
sentences.zh: 它只是一块地毯，这就是我的看法。

sentences.en: The machine they're using to remove the carpet looks like a cross between a motorized wheelchair and a Zamboni.
sentences.zh: 他们用来拆除地毯的机器看起来像是电动轮椅和冰面清理车的结合体。

sentences.en: It's called a panther.
sentences.zh: 它叫“黑豹”。

sentences.en: You attach the carpet to the machine and drive it forward to pull up these huge sections of carpet all at once.
sentences.zh: 你把地毯连接到机器上，然后向前驱动，就能一次性拉起这些巨大的地毯部分。

sentences.en: Most of this work will be done at night so it can have minimal impact on travelers.
sentences.zh: 大部分工作将在夜间进行，以尽量减少对旅客的影响。

sentences.en: And it's going to take a long time.
sentences.zh: 而且这需要很长时间。

sentences.en: 13 acres of carpet does not get panthered away overnight.
sentences.zh: 13英亩的地毯不可能一夜之间被“黑豹”清理干净。

sentences.en: If all goes well and perfectly, it will be earlier than November.
sentences.zh: 如果一切顺利且完美，它会在11月之前完成。

sentences.en: But we're giving it a healthy window and we're saying before Thanksgiving of this year it will be completely done.
sentences.zh: 但我们给了一个充裕的时间窗口，我们说在今年感恩节之前它会完全完成。

sentences.en: When the carpet is all removed, most of it will be sent back to the manufacturer and recycled.
sentences.zh: 当地毯全部拆除后，大部分将被送回制造商处进行回收。

sentences.en: But not all of it.
sentences.zh: 但并非全部。

sentences.en: They're giving away four 1,000 square yard pieces.
sentences.zh: 他们正在赠送四块1000平方码的地毯。

sentences.en: Businesses will have to submit proposals to get one, outlining what they plan to do with the carpet,
sentences.zh: 企业必须提交提案来获取其中一块，概述他们计划如何处理这块地毯，

sentences.en: how they will store it in the meantime, and how they will eventually make it available to the general public.
sentences.zh: 在此期间如何储存它，以及最终如何向公众展示它。

sentences.en: Whatever happens to the old PDX carpet, one thing is for sure.
sentences.zh: 无论旧的PDX地毯发生了什么，有一点是肯定的。

sentences.en: Its replacement has some big shoes to fill.
sentences.zh: 它的继任者将面临巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: People are going to hate it.
sentences.zh: 人们会讨厌它的。

sentences.en: Well, hopefully not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，希望不会。

sentences.en: It might be a perfectly great design, but people will still hate it.
sentences.zh: 它可能是一个非常棒的设计，但人们仍然会讨厌它。

sentences.en: They'll say, why didn't you replace all the carpet and use the same beloved design?
sentences.zh: 他们会说，为什么你们不更换所有地毯并使用同样受人喜爱的设计呢？

sentences.en: If they had decided to just re-carpet with the same design, that would have been cool.
sentences.zh: 如果他们决定只用同样的设计重新铺设地毯，那会很酷。

sentences.en: See?
sentences.zh: 看吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, it does seem like the most obvious solution.
sentences.zh: 是的，这看起来确实是最显而易见的解决方案。

sentences.en: But the decision to replace the carpet was made back in 2008,
sentences.zh: 但更换地毯的决定是在2008年做出的，

sentences.en: before all the foot selfies and hashtag PDX carpet.
sentences.zh: 在所有的足部自拍和PDX地毯标签出现之前。

sentences.en: I don't think at that time there was an awareness of that great sentiment
sentences.zh: 我不认为当时人们意识到了那种伟大的情感，

sentences.en: that exists in the community for the carpet.
sentences.zh: 即社区对地毯存在的那种情感。

sentences.en: That we became aware of more recently.
sentences.zh: 那是我们最近才意识到的。

sentences.en: Did you ever consider replacing the carpet with the same design?
sentences.zh: 你们有没有考虑过用同样的设计来更换地毯？

sentences.en: I think that we had thoughts about people asking that question once we were well into it,
sentences.zh: 我想当我们深入项目时，我们确实考虑过人们会问这个问题，

sentences.en: and had already kind of come up with a conceptual design.
sentences.zh: 而且当时已经构思出了一个概念设计。

sentences.en: Now, when you walk through the airport, you can actually see a sizable swatch of the new carpet.
sentences.zh: 现在，当你走过机场时，你实际上可以看到一大块新地毯的样本。

sentences.en: It's a darker green with a repeating geometric motif that's reminiscent of the old carpet, but busier.
sentences.zh: 它是一种深绿色，带有重复的几何图案，让人想起旧地毯，但更繁复。

sentences.en: The busyness of the new design actually helps hide dirt and other wear and tear.
sentences.zh: 新设计的繁复感实际上有助于掩盖污垢和其他磨损。

sentences.en: In fact, there's a couple different versions of the new design.
sentences.zh: 事实上，新设计有几个不同的版本。

sentences.en: One that's extra busy that they'll lay in higher traffic areas.
sentences.zh: 其中一个特别繁复的版本，他们会铺在人流量更大的区域。

sentences.en: It looks like a tropical Jimmy Buffett version of the airport carpet, and not in a good way.
sentences.zh: 它看起来就像机场地毯的热带吉米·巴菲特版，而且不是那种好的意义上的。

sentences.en: Jeremy Dunn, the sock maker, is not a fan.
sentences.zh: 袜子制造商杰里米·邓恩并不喜欢它。

sentences.en: It seems very swoopy, and like, you know, it has more curves to it, and it's a little bit different green, and it's a little, it has some yellow in there, you know,
sentences.zh: 它看起来非常弯曲，而且，你知道，它有更多的曲线，绿色也稍微有点不同，还有一点，里面带点黄色，你知道，

sentences.en: and I think those are all, to me, those are all things that are not as appealing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得对我来说，这些都是不太吸引人的地方。

sentences.en: Are you going to make socks with a new design?
sentences.zh: 你打算用新设计制作袜子吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, probably not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大概不会。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it's tough if people don't have an immediate love.
sentences.zh: 是的，我觉得如果人们不能立刻爱上它，那就很难办了。

sentences.en: Everybody wishes that their design work was immediately adored.
sentences.zh: 每个人都希望自己的设计作品能立刻受到喜爱。

sentences.en: Michelle Vo is a partner at Henneberry Eddy, the firm that took on the unenviable challenge of designing the replacement carpet.
sentences.zh: 米歇尔·沃是亨内伯里·埃迪建筑事务所的合伙人，该事务所承担了设计替换地毯这一艰巨任务。

sentences.en: And like most design work, there's a lot of thought and consideration that went into it.
sentences.zh: 像大多数设计工作一样，其中倾注了大量的思考和考量。

sentences.en: The inspiration for this had a lot to do with what you see from the air as you're coming in,
sentences.zh: 这个设计的灵感很大程度上源于你从空中飞抵时所看到的景象，

sentences.en: and that green color that's the main background color for the carpet is much like that experience of flying into Portland.
sentences.zh: 而那种作为地毯主背景色的绿色，非常像飞往波特兰时的那种体验。

sentences.en: We have a unique situation here where coming into Portland, the greenery of our surroundings come right up to the doorstep of our city.
sentences.zh: 我们这里有一种独特的情况，那就是在进入波特兰时，我们周围的绿意直接延伸到了城市的门口。

sentences.en: And those swoopy lines?
sentences.zh: 至于那些弯曲的线条？

sentences.en: Also, we're looking at some of the, that flight path, that pattern of that curvature as you're flying in.
sentences.zh: 我们也在观察一些，就是那条飞行路径，那种你在飞入时看到的曲率模式。

sentences.en: You know, if you were to look at kind of the way that aircraft curve around to align with the runways and come in.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你观察飞机为了对准跑道而转弯并降落的方式。

sentences.en: Did you ever think about how people's feet would look on the new carpet?
sentences.zh: 你有没有想过人们的脚踩在新地毯上会是什么样子？

sentences.en: No, actually, I didn't.
sentences.zh: 不，实际上，我没想过。

sentences.en: Even with all this thought and care, designer Michelle Vo is fully aware that this new carpet is going to be a hard sell.
sentences.zh: 尽管倾注了所有的思考和心血，设计师米歇尔·沃完全意识到这款新地毯将很难推销。

sentences.en: But she hopes it will grow on people over time.
sentences.zh: 但她希望随着时间的推移，人们会逐渐喜欢上它。

sentences.en: I think that the new carpet going down is something that will become endearing.
sentences.zh: 我认为铺设的新地毯会成为一种令人喜爱的事物。

sentences.en: I hope that it will, and maybe it won't reach cult status until 20 years out when it's time to replace it.
sentences.zh: 我希望会这样，也许它要到20年后该更换时才能达到那种崇拜地位。

sentences.en: But, you know, that's okay.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，那也没关系。

sentences.en: That's okay.
sentences.zh: 那没关系。

sentences.en: You can't manufacture a cult following for an airport carpet.
sentences.zh: 你无法人为制造出对机场地毯的狂热追捧。

sentences.en: It has to happen on its own.
sentences.zh: 它必须自然而然地发生。

sentences.en: You don't say.
sentences.zh: 你可别说。

sentences.en: But I do think that part of the reason that people fell in love with the carpet is because
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为人们爱上旧地毯的部分原因是

sentences.en: people have a lot of love for the airport itself,
sentences.zh: 人们对机场本身怀有深厚的感情，

sentences.en: which has kind of become a microcosm of Portland.
sentences.zh: 它已经成为了波特兰的一个缩影。

sentences.en: With local restaurants and food carts in the terminal,
sentences.zh: 航站楼里有当地的餐馆和餐车，

sentences.en: there's even a mini farmer's market in the sea concourse.
sentences.zh: C大厅甚至还有一个小型农贸市场。

sentences.en: And so maybe the new carpet will eventually become a part of the airport the same way the old carpet did.
sentences.zh: 所以也许新地毯最终会像旧地毯一样，成为机场的一部分。

sentences.en: Crucial to the experience of coming home to Portland.
sentences.zh: 这对回到波特兰的体验至关重要。

sentences.en: Then again, maybe not.
sentences.zh: 话又说回来，也许不会。

sentences.en: It's a lot like just having anything in your childhood replaced with something.
sentences.zh: 这就像把你童年里的任何东西换掉一样。

sentences.en: You're kind of resentful towards the new whatever it may be.
sentences.zh: 你会对新的东西产生某种怨恨，无论那是什么。

sentences.en: And you could potentially grow to like it,
sentences.zh: 你可能会逐渐喜欢上它，

sentences.en: but it'll never be the same as the original thing that you loved.
sentences.zh: 但它永远不会像你最初喜爱的那个东西一样。

sentences.en: Someday, Emma may love the new carpet.
sentences.zh: 总有一天，艾玛可能会喜欢上新地毯。

sentences.en: Like someday, I might learn to appreciate Star Wars The Phantom Menace,
sentences.zh: 就像总有一天，我可能会学会欣赏《星球大战：幽灵的威胁》，

sentences.en: with its Jar Jar Binks and midichlorian microbes that control the force.
sentences.zh: 欣赏里面那个加·加·宾克斯和控制原力的纤原体微生物。

sentences.en: And no, there's no way I'll ever like it.
sentences.zh: 不，我永远不可能喜欢它。

sentences.en: You hear me, George Lucas?
sentences.zh: 你听到了吗，乔治·卢卡斯？

sentences.en: I'll never like it.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会喜欢它。

sentences.en: You ruined it.
sentences.zh: 你毁了它。

sentences.en: You ruined everything.
sentences.zh: 你毁了一切。
